description.value: Intermezzo Restaurant and Wine Cellar has been a fine-dining fixture in downtown Vernon since 1977, operating as a family-run establishment with everything made in-house from scratch. The menu draws on global inspiration — Moroccan lamb, West Coast seafood, house-made gnocchi — paired with a cellar of over 100 wines including many Okanagan labels. A sister venue, The Castle Bistro, operates about 8 minutes north of the downtown location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and provides strong evidence. The contact page confirms address (3206 34th Ave, Vernon, BC V1T 7E2) and phone (1-250-542-3853). Takeout is explicitly confirmed on the take-out page. The contact page explicitly notes bathrooms exist but are up a flight of stairs. No mention of bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site. One menu item is explicitly labeled gluten free.
concerns: OSM tags contain no phone, address, or email — all contact details sourced from website only; contact_confirmed is null for phone and address as there is nothing in OSM to corroborate.
Washroom accessibility issue noted on website: bathrooms are up a flight of stairs, which may affect some cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Long-established fine-dining restaurant in downtown Vernon with confirmed takeout service — a practical stop for touring cyclists seeking a sit-down meal or takeout in the Okanagan. No cycling-specific amenities confirmed, but the core food-and-drink offering is solid.
enrichment_extras.notes: Restaurant has a second location, The Castle Bistro, approximately 8 minutes north of the downtown address — this OSM record covers the downtown location only.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: At least one gluten-free item explicitly noted on the menu: 'Callebaut Chocolate Truffle (gluten free)'. No explicit vegetarian or vegan labelling observed

wow_evidence: fine-dining fixture in downtown Vernon since 1977, operating as a family-run establishment

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: Fine-dining positioning, 100+ wine cellar ($30–$500/bottle), premium ingredients (Alaskan king crab, fillet mignon, black truffles)
